component.name: lazysite
component.description: TAPPaaS module lazysite: triage of its own critical/high CVEs (#788). nginx on :8080, behind the firewall's Caddy, serves the site and hands pages to the lazysite FastCGI processor (Perl). Verified live on hrossen: libxslt is in the closure only because nginx is built with --with-http_xslt_module; the generated nginx.conf contains no xslt directive, only the nginx processes load libxslt, and nginx links libxml2 2.15.4.

analysis.detail: libxslt is only linked into nginx's built-in xslt filter, and the lazysite nginx.conf has no xslt_stylesheet directive, so no XSLT is ever run; the libxml2 it links (2.15.4) also carries the upstream mitigation (>= 2.14.5).
